name: set_manifest
description: Set a manifest field: id, title, description, needs, icon or version.

name: set_query
description: Set the tq query that picks the files the agent opens.

name: write_skill
description: Write a file of the agent's skills folder (SKILL.md first, with name and description frontmatter).

name: remove_skill
description: Remove a file of the agent's skills folder.

name: upsert_tool
description: Add or replace a tool: { name, kind: message|view|module, description, params, result? }.

name: write_module
description: Replace the agent's module with the whole new source. Answers with the check.

name: upsert_sample
description: Add or replace a sample, as tdata JSON text. "empty" is what New opens.

name: reorder_samples
description: Move a sample to index (0 is first): the order the agent's samples are written in.

name: check
description: Check the agent as the app will use it.

name: install
description: Install the agent in this app (after check passes).
